title: Figure 4: Active Denial System With FLAPS Antenna on Humvee
description: Black-and-white photograph of a military Humvee carrying the Active Denial System, with a large flat panel FLAPS (flat parabolic surface) antenna raised above the vehicle. The caption reads "Figure 4. Active Denial System With FLAPS Antenna." The text describes the 95 GHz gyrotron-based, less-than-lethal crowd-dispersal weapon and impulse HPM sources such as SNIPER and EMBL.
